decisions.reason: The source changes prize winner counts and draw frequencies but explicitly preserves the net giveaway amount; it does not change which sales fund the pools or the funding duration.
The no-referral trigger, random recipient, commission, and award of Small and Big Block tickets remain unchanged.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records one winner and a sales-count trigger of 10,000; the unchanged $10,000 prize amount requires no additional update.
Changing prize quantities and draw frequencies does not alter the requirement to expose Small and Big Block ticket counters or permanent badges in NFT metadata.
The source does not change the mint price, founder share, referral commission, or the requirement that primary mints fund prize pools.
The source changes prize draw parameters but does not change the required flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
Winner counts and draw frequencies do not resolve or change the existing uncertainty between automatic prize payout and manual claiming.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records one winner and a sales-count trigger of 100; the unchanged $500 prize amount requires no additional update.
The source changes prize quantities and draw frequencies but leaves random ticket-weighted Chainlink VRF winner selection unchanged.
The prize parameter change has no effect on the Transak fiat-payment provider, supported payment methods, or non-crypto buyer flow.
The source does not change confirmation-email availability or its mint-number referral-code content.
The prize parameter change does not alter the NFT ebook asset delivered by mint fulfillment.
